correctness.rationale: The full graph-ball list gives a continuous piecewise-linear edge map on all R^k. Jacobian column-sum bounds cover the hub selecting zero, global mean, or a single positive pair, with a separate correct incompatibility lemma for k=3. The k=1 formula is direct. Strict branch regions and explicit nonnegative pairs attain the constants for every k. Exact-rational independent ball enumeration and finite branch checks were replayed; universal proof does not depend on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: Graph-total-variation sensitivity to perturbations is a natural nonlinear stability invariant distinct from one-input smoothing. The exact family-wide result exhibits an exceptional k=3 threshold, linear branching amplification, concrete witnesses, and an explicit asymptotic gap approaching one from the same-operator one-input norm. Unlike a routine restatement, it measures differences of images and reveals a structurally distinct response to infinitesimal input changes.
